WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    ABS(SUM(COALESCE(oi.price, 0) + COALESCE(oi.freight_value, 0))) AS order_total
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
order_pay_plans AS (
  SELECT
    op.order_id,
    MAX(COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 1)) AS max_installments
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN opp.max_installments > 1 THEN 'installments' ELSE 'full_payment' END AS payment_plan,
  AVG(ABS(ot.order_total)) AS average_order_value,
  COUNT(*) AS orders_count
FROM order_totals ot
JOIN order_pay_plans opp ON ot.order_id = opp.order_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN opp.max_installments > 1 THEN 'installments' ELSE 'full_payment' END
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;
